title: Imp Hub X Auto Quest Auto Best Zone Auto Train Auto Farm Mob
features:
Game: Anime Fighting Simulator Endless
💪 TRAINING & STATS
• Auto Train:
 * Modes: Normal, Fast, Intense (Instant spam).
 * Custom Delay: Adjustable slider for training speed.
   • Smart Automation:
 * Auto Train Recommended: Automatically detects your stats and teleports you to the best possible zone you can use.
 * Zone Scanner: Reads internal game data to update zone requirements in real-time.
 * Load All Zones: Teleports to every zone to force the map to render (fixes teleport bugs).
   • Zone Management:
 * Train In Zone: Forces character to stay in the selected zone.
 * Custom Zones: Create, Save, Name, and Delete your own custom farm spots.
   • Quests:
 * Auto Boom Quest: Auto accepts and farms stats for Boom.
 * Auto Reindeer Quest: Auto accepts and farms stats for Reindeer.
 * UI Integration: Reads quest progress directly from the game screen.
   • Auto Upgrade:
 * Methods: Selected Stats or Fair Mode (Keeps all stats balanced).
 * Custom Delay: Adjustable upgrade timer.
⚔️ COMBAT & FARMING
• Auto Mob Farm:
 * Mob Scanner: Automatically detects all mobs currently in the server.
 * Teleport Methods: Instant or Tween (Smooth).
 * Farm Styles: Priority Closest, Selected Only, or Random.
   • Combat Settings:
 * Fast Attack: Spams attack remote.
 * Auto Skills: Automatically uses skills on mobs.
 * Skill Methods: Remote (Direct server invoke) or Simulation (Virtual key presses - Legit).
 * Key Selector: Choose exactly which keys (A-Z) to spam.
🏆 CHAMPIONS & CAPSULES
• Smart Equip:
 * Auto Equip Best: Automatically calculates and equips the best champion for the specific stat you are currently training.
 * Zone Equip: Switches champions automatically when changing training zones.
   • Auto Open:
 * Select Capsule (1 or 2).
 * Adjustable Open Delay.
   • Advanced Filters:
 * Open Until Champion: Stops when you get a specific unit.
 * Open Until Low Chikara: Stops when currency drops below 5k.
 * Stop Limit: Input a custom Chikara amount to stop at.
 * Auto Delete: Automatically sells champions not in your Wanted or Maintain lists.
🎒 MISC & COLLECTION
• Web Code Scraper (High Tier):
 * Connects to an external website (Gamerant).
 * Parses HTML to find the latest active codes.
 * Automatically redeems every code found.
   • Item Collection:
 * Auto Chikara: Teleport or Instant Collect.
 * Auto Fruits: Teleport or Instant Collect.
 * Instant Method: Uses fireclickdetector to collect items without moving (God Mode).
   • Auto Gacha: Automatically buys buffs (Jutsu, Nen, Hero, Soul, etc.).
   • Auto Class: Automatically unlocks new classes when requirements are met.
👁️ VISUALS (ESP)
• Drawing API: High-performance, zero-lag ESP.
• Chikara ESP: Box, Tracer, Distance, Custom Color.
• Fruit ESP: Box, Tracer, Distance, Custom Color.
📡 DISCORD WEBHOOKS
• Detailed Logging: Sends embeds to your Discord server.
• Triggers:
 * Stat Gains (Chikara, Total Power, Yen) - Calculates profit.
 * New Class Unlocked.
 * Fruit Spawned.
 * New Champion Obtained.
 * Wanted Champion Found.
   • Configuration: Custom Webhook URL + Ping Everyone toggle.
